module: Campaign dealer: holds a stock (M.state.stock) keyed by uppercase item type. A stock is either a list of tables (vehicles {model, config}) or an accumulated number. Saved and restored with the campaign (onSaveCampaign / onResumeCampaign). The buy function is empty (not implemented).
notes: addToStock and removeFromStock uppercase itemType; getStock does not: it must therefore be given the type already in uppercase.

Probable bug: existItem considers an entry a duplicate as soon as a single field of the existing entry equals that of valueObj (not all fields); two vehicles of the same model with a different config are therefore seen as identical.
removeFromStock compares the model and config of the entries and leaves debug prints; for a numeric stock it subtracts the value.
onDeserialized only logs; onResumeCampaign replaces M.state with the received data (without copying).

addToStock.desc: Adds an object (table, no duplicates according to existItem) or a quantity (number) to the stock of the given type. Creates the entry if needed.

getStock.desc: Returns a deep copy of the stock of a type (creates an empty list if absent).

removeFromStock.desc: Removes from the stock the first entry whose model and config match (table value) or subtracts the quantity (number value).

valueObj.desc: Object {model, config} to remove or quantity.

buy.desc: Intended to buy an object from the stock; the body is empty in this version.

index.desc: Position of the object (inferred from the name).

onSerialize.desc: Serialization hook: returns a deep copy of M.state.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after deserialization; only logs.

onSaveCampaign.desc: Campaign save hook: calls saveCallback(M.__globalAlias__, copy of the state).

onResumeCampaign.desc: Campaign resume hook: replaces M.state with data.
